name: Standard Notes
description_en:
Standard Notes is an end-to-end encrypted personal note service with offline access and sync across unlimited devices. The free Standard experience centres on plain text, while paid Productivity and Professional unlock richer editors, longer history and, at the top tier, encrypted files.

The current official product and plan pages are on standardnotes.com; the inherited .org address failed during this research. Open-source clients and self-hosting options are separate from the entitlements of a hosted subscription.
description_zh:
Standard Notes 是端到端加密的个人笔记服务，提供离线访问与不限设备同步。免费 Standard 以纯文字为中心，付费 Productivity 和 Professional 开放更丰富编辑器、更长历史，以及最高档的加密文件。

当前官方产品和套餐页位于 standardnotes.com；继承的 .org 地址在本次读取中失败。开源客户端、自行托管选项与托管订阅权益需要分别理解。

core_features.explanation_en: Standard includes encrypted text notes and unlimited device sync.
core_features.explanation_zh: Standard 包含加密文字笔记与不限设备同步。

core_features.explanation_en: Productivity adds Super notes and spreadsheets.
core_features.explanation_zh: Productivity 增加 Super 笔记与电子表格。

core_features.explanation_en: Home Server and traditional HTTPS backend options have client conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: Home Server 与传统 HTTPS 后端有客户端适用条件。

en: Keep encrypted personal notes with a deliberate backup strategy.
zh: 以明确备份策略保存加密个人笔记。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor service or documented desktop Home Server/traditional self-hosting.
Deployment.zh: 厂商服务，或文档所列桌面 Home Server／传统自行托管。

steps.en: Start with a free plain text note and export a non-sensitive sample.
steps.zh: 从免费纯文字笔记开始，导出非敏感样例。

steps.en: Check whether the required editor/history/files are in the intended tier.
steps.zh: 确认所需编辑器／历史／文件属于目标档位。

steps.en: If hosting, verify the HTTPS endpoint and supported client before moving data.
steps.zh: 若自行托管，迁移前验证 HTTPS 地址及支持的客户端。

items.en: Standard shows current-session history, Productivity one year and Professional maximum history on the comparison. Separate plan history from an independently retained backup and test a non-sensitive export/restore before relying on it for unique records. The official app repository licence is AGPLv3; this research did not inspect every server/editor component licence. It fits personal encrypted records; collaboration, password recovery boundaries, file restore and subscription entitlements on self-hosted infrastructure need focused verification.
items.zh: 对照表把 Standard 历史列为当前会话，Productivity 一年，Professional 最大历史。应区分套餐历史与独立保存的备份，依赖唯一记录前用非敏感数据测试导出／恢复。官方应用仓库许可为 AGPLv3；本次未检查每个服务器／编辑器组件许可。它适合个人加密记录；协作、密码恢复边界、文件恢复及自行托管下的订阅权益需专项确认。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual hosted subscriptions; self-hosting entitlement separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Standard free; Productivity $90/year; Professional $120/year. No paid-feature trial; refund windows 14 and 90 days respectively.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Standard 免费；Productivity 每年 90；Professional 每年 120。付费功能无试用；退款期分别 14 与 90 天。

review_notes: Primary-source research is a draft, not publication, owner verification, price approval or independent review.
English and Chinese carry matching amounts, billing periods, qualifications and unknowns.
Historical directory assertions are superseded, including unverified feature and API labels.

sections.title_en: Choose the note type before migrating
sections.title_zh: 迁移前先选择笔记类型
sections.en: For an illustrative private journal, start with a plain text note and tags, verify it on a second device and export a copy. The plan page includes encryption, offline access, two-factor authentication and encrypted/plaintext export in Standard. Rich Markdown/checklists/code in the Super note type and spreadsheets belong to Productivity. A rich source document should be tested in the intended editor rather than assuming plain text will preserve its structure.
sections.zh: 例如私密日志可从纯文字笔记和标签开始，在第二设备核对，再导出副本。套餐页把加密、离线、双因素认证及加密／纯文字导出列入 Standard。Super 类型中的丰富 Markdown／清单／代码与电子表格属于 Productivity。富格式来源文档应在目标编辑器验证，不能默认纯文字保留原结构。

sections.title_en: A refund window is not a free trial
sections.title_zh: 退款期不等于免费试用
sections.en: The current page lists Productivity $90/year and Professional $120/year. Professional includes 100 GB encrypted file storage and sharing a subscription with up to five accounts; that does not mean co-editing one note. The FAQ explicitly says paid features have no trial system. Instead, it states a 14-day refund period for Productivity and 90 days for Professional. Free Standard is ongoing; local currency, tax and checkout treatment were not independently confirmed.
sections.zh: 当前页面列 Productivity 每年 90、Professional 每年 120。Professional 含 100 GB 加密文件存储，可与最多五个账户共享订阅；这不代表共同编辑同一笔记。FAQ 明确说明付费功能没有试用系统，而是 Productivity 14 天退款期、Professional 90 天退款期。免费 Standard 持续可用；未独立确认地区币种、税费与结账处理。

sections.title_en: Home Server and custom sync have prerequisites
sections.title_zh: Home Server 与自定义同步有前提
sections.en: Official self-hosting help describes enabling Home Server in the desktop app, available on the local network while that computer and app remain running. Traditional hosting exposes an HTTPS backend endpoint configured in desktop/mobile clients; the production web app cannot connect to that custom server. Hosting a web client is separate. These options transfer uptime, backups and access configuration to the operator; a self-hosted server does not automatically grant paid editors.
sections.zh: 官方自行托管帮助说明，可在桌面应用启用 Home Server，在电脑及应用持续运行时供本地网络访问。传统托管则暴露 HTTPS 后端地址，在桌面／移动客户端配置；生产 Web 应用不能连接该自定义服务。自行托管网页客户端是另一事项。这些选项让运营者承担运行时间、备份与访问配置，不能默认自建服务器就获得付费编辑器。

sections.title_en: Private notes still need recoverable backups
sections.title_zh: 私密笔记仍需可恢复备份

Separate plan history from an independently retained backup and test a non-sensitive export/restore before relying on it for unique records. The official app repository licence is AGPLv3; this research did not inspect every server/editor component licence. It fits personal encrypted records; collaboration, password recovery boundaries, file restore and subscription entitlements on self-hosted infrastructure need focused verification.

research_gaps.en: No encryption audit, account recovery, restore, live sync, self-host deployment or regional checkout was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未进行加密审计、账户恢复、还原、真实同步、自行部署或地区结账。
